title: Firefox browsing history
whyItMatters: Lists every page visited with timestamps and visit counts, plus bookmarks and tags. It shows interests, habits and often which services the person uses.
source: Mozilla Support, profiles where Firefox stores user data (places.sqlite): https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/profiles-where-firefox-stores-user-data
notes: One places.sqlite per profile, with places.sqlite-wal and -shm alongside while Firefox is open.
